kinshipCharterTitle: Kinship Charter (ธรรมนูญญาติ)
kinshipCharterIntro: A shared, non-legal code of conduct guests, hosts, and producers agree to inside BAANYARD — modeled on the Naga (grounded, water & land) and Garuda (sky, protection) balance from the founding brand story.
kinshipCharterFair: Fairness — communities receive a disclosed, fair share of every sale (illustrative split shown per chain).
kinshipCharterSafe: Safety — food & craft lots note residue/quality checks before listing; no health claims without a named lab.
kinshipCharterSustain: Sustainability — heirloom seed, dye plants, and river ecosystems are protected; no extractive sourcing.
kinshipGuardiansBody: Local อสม. (village health volunteers) and community leaders act as on-the-ground quality & safety guardians for each chain — an illustrative role, not a government appointment.
kinshipPartnersBody: In discussion, not yet signed: Sakon Nakhon Rice Research Center (variety trials), Kasetsart University & Rajamangala University of Technology Isan (lab/quality certification), Sakon Nakhon Rajabhat University Tourism program (experience design & fieldwork). No certification badge is claimed until an MOU is signed.
brandStoryTitle: Why BAANYARD · Barn + Yard, Naga + Garuda
brandStoryBarnYard: BAANYARD = Barn (โรงนา, abundance — the granary of rice and wisdom) + Yard (ลาน, an open gathering ground) — a home for relatives, not a marketplace stall.
brandStoryNagaGaruda: Our mark balances Naga (นาค — the land- and water-rooted host community) with Garuda (ครุฑ — protection, reach, and trust) so neither side is erased: local roots carry the weight, the platform carries the shelter.
brandStoryTagline: "อุษาคเนย์เป็นญาติกัน" — Southeast Asia, all kin.
